svg.title: I’m Alberto Davis, a Full Stack Developer. I build web applications with PHP, MySQL, JavaScript and Python, from the database to the interface. My work spans business websites, booking systems, desktop tools and data analysis. I also explore networking, interface design and cybersecurity fundamentals.
